whatsNew: Missed-Event Catch-Up: if the screen was off when an event fired, opening the app now surfaces a recovery modal listing every missed event. Run each one in order or skip — modal stays until all are addressed.
notes: Critical fix: previous deploys (v9.10.191-194) were built from a doubled HTML file (entire app duplicated inside one file), causing two copies of every function and startup call to execute simultaneously. Rebuilt cleanly from v9.10.190 single-block base. All v9.10.191-192 features (catch-up scan, Help tab updates) reapplied correctly.
